description: T1 item 1 (design sources shipped): the eight RTL sources of the committed crypto_rot_top synthesis request (the AES, HMAC/SHA-256, key-ladder, DRBG, TRNG-interface and top-level modules) and the committed gate-level netlist derived from them, whose freshness check (verification/rtl/crypto_rot_top/netlist/check-fresh.sh) re-runs the committed klt synthesize request and byte-compares against the committed netlist -- issue #88. The check is local_only: it needs the PDK and the pinned synthesis toolchain (about 80 s of yosys), beyond what klt signoff --check should run; ci.yml runs it on every PR touching rtl/ or verification/. Correctness of the derivation only; no security or side-channel claim.
